chunks: A person in the state of ihram must not guide others to game. If he does guide someone to it and it is killed, then the expiation is upon him.

key_terms.ٱلْفِدَاءُ: the expiation or compensatory payment due
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a muhrim guides someone to game and it is killed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the muhrim during ihram: he must not indicate or guide others to game. If he does so and the animal is killed as a result, he becomes liable for the required expiation.
